items.title: Alkenes ki physical khusoosiyat (print mein doosra 11.6.2) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Physical Properties of alkenes, printed as a second 11.6.2 on page 256.

items: Pehle teen arkan, ethene, propene aur butene, kamre ke darja hararat par gases hain; C5 se C15 liquids aur oonche arkan solids.
Yeh pani mein na-halne wale magar alcohol mein halne wale hain.
In ki khaas boo hoti hai aur yeh roshan (luminous) sholay se jalte hain.
Alkanes ke bar-aks yeh sp2 hybridisation ki wajah se halki polar khusoosiyat dikhate hain.

blocks.prompt: Ethene roshan sholay se kyun jalti hai jabke ethane saaf jalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Ethene mein ethane se carbon-hydrogen ka tanasub ooncha hai, to us ka jalna aasani se na-mukammal hota hai aur bina jale carbon ke zarraat sholay mein chamakte hain, use roshan aur dhuan-dar banate hue.

items: Alkenes: C2-C4 gases, C5-C15 liquids, phir solids; pani mein na-halne wale, alcohol mein halne wale; khaas boo, roshan shola; sp2 carbons se halki polar.
